English: Prayer Mat Stand
A simple tented stand where the faithful gather on mats for communal prayers, fostering unity among the clan.
Wooden Mihrab
A modest wooden niche marks the direction of prayer, lending legitimacy and formality to nomadic worship.
Stone Niche
A semi-permanent stone mihrab, signifying a growing and respected Muslim presence among the clan.
Minaret Pavilion
A canvas pavilion with a wooden minaret, allowing for the call to prayer to echo across the steppe.
Imams Room
A dedicated tent for the imam, providing guidance, mediation, and spiritual leadership to the nomadic clan.
Sanctified Chamber
A robust, semi-permanent prayer chamber, sanctified for special rites and enhanced spiritual gatherings.
Altar Hall
A large gathering hall with an ornate altar, hosting festive prayers, assemblies, and clan ceremonies.
Community Mosque
A fully-formed mosque complex, uniting the clan and neighboring nomads in worship and learning.
Grand Mosque Room
A grand tented hall, richly adorned, serves as the spiritual heart of the clans faith and gathering place for regional leaders.
Muslim Grand Mosque
The ultimate symbol of Islamic faith on the steppes: a grand mosque with a minaret visible for miles, drawing pilgrims and uniting the clans under one spiritual banner.
